title: Machine-Learned Renormalization-Group-Improved Gauge Actions and Classically Perfect Gradient Flows
abstract: Develops specialized neural networks to parameterize lattice QFT actions that satisfy fixed-point equations, enabling even coarse lattices to yield remarkably small errors. Solves a 30-year-old challenge in particle physics computational methods. The AI is designed from the outset to guarantee compliance with physical symmetries. Opens a completely new way to simulate complex quantum field theories with manageable computational effort.
key_claims: Neural network parameterization of lattice actions satisfying fixed-point equations
Coarse lattices achieve remarkably small errors with AI-optimized actions
Custom neural network designed to guarantee physical law compliance from the outset
Solves 30-year-old challenge in lattice QFT formulation optimization
Enables simulation of complex QFTs with manageable computational effort
